topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I had been chatting with Alex for months, both of us sharing our daily lives and deepest thoughts. It was pure coincidence that we mentioned our cities in a conversation, and it turned out we shared the same one. I felt a knot form in my stomach, thinking about all the times I mentioned my city without revealing I lived there. I suggested we grab coffee sometime, but my enthusiasm felt forced. We did meet up, and it was nice, but I couldn’t shake the weight of keeping my location a secret for so long. I hope it doesn’t strain our friendship.
